'You may destroy a Gold you control RATHER THAN PAY this card's {r} cost.'

An ALTERNATIVE cost, not an additional one: it REPLACES the resource cost, so a controller with a Gold can play the card for no resources at all. As an additional_cost it would be charged on top of the {r}, which is the opposite of what the card does.

The ability has no effects on purpose -- the card's whole text IS the alternative cost, and its {d} comes from the card DB. tests/test_card_json_hygiene.py exempts an effect-less ability that carries one, for exactly this shape.
